experience.productDescription: An enterprise platform connecting enterprise infrastructure securely to public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP).
highlights: Build cloud-native backend services for IZO Multi Cloud Connect, an enterprise platform connecting enterprise infrastructure securely to public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Design and build REST APIs and service-to-service integrations using Java and Spring Boot, across Controller, Service, and Repository layers.
Implement asynchronous, event-driven processing between services using RabbitMQ message queues, decoupling services and improving resilience under load.
Model relational data and write efficient queries in PostgreSQL and MySQL, and use Redis in microservices for caching and fast in-memory data access.
Own scoped features end to end – implementation, automated testing, and deployment through Jenkins CI/CD – and demo completed functionality to QA.
Write automated unit and integration tests with JUnit and Mockito; uphold code quality with SonarQube.
Debug Dockerized microservices via container logs and environment configuration, fixing issues at the root cause.
Use GitHub Copilot extensively, including Agent mode across multiple models, for implementation, testing, debugging, and code exploration, reviewing and validating generated code before it ships.
Participate in code and design reviews; collaborate with Product Owners and QA in Agile sprints.
